Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing payment for critical services rendered by out-of-network providers in in-network hospitals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to payment for critical services rendered by outofnetwork providers in innetwork hospitals; and adding a new sectionto chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) A hospital with an emergency department shall post in aconspicuous manner in its reception area a sign indicating whether theproviders in the emergency department are nonparticipating providerswith any of the health carriers with whom the hospital participates.A hospital is not required to comply with this requirement if theproviders in its emergency department participate with all of thecarriers with whom the hospital participates. (b) A hospital with an emergency department shall provide theinformation required in (a) of this subsection to every patientreceiving emergency services in the emergency department, or thepatient's representative, when obtaining informed consent for theemergency services. The hospital is not required to comply with this p. 1 SHB 1561subsection if to do so would endanger the life or health of thepatient. (c) A hospital that does not comply with the requirements of thissection shall promptly reimburse the patient for any amount billed tothe patient by a nonparticipating provider for emergency services, withthe exception of any applicable cost sharing. (2)(a) In any explanation of benefits sent to a covered person, ahealth carrier shall inform the covered person: (i) Whether any covered emergency services were provided by anonparticipating provider; (ii) That the covered person may be subject to billing by thenonparticipating provider for the difference between the amount paid bythe health carrier and the provider's billed charges; and (iii) That the amount billed by the nonparticipating provider isoften subject to negotiation and that the covered person may wish tocontact the provider about the bill. (b) A health carrier that does not comply with (a) of thissubsection shall promptly reimburse the covered person for any amountbilled to the patient by a nonparticipating provider for emergencyservices, with the exception of any applicable cost sharing. (3)(a) A nonparticipating provider who bills a covered person foremergency services shall inform the person in writing that: (i) The amount in the bill may not be reflective of the provider'sactual costs and may be subject to negotiation; and (ii) The covered person may not be responsible for paying theamount under subsection (1)(b) or (2)(b) of this section. (b) A nonparticipating provider who does not comply with thissubsection (3) shall promptly refund any amounts collected from thecovered person, with the exception of any applicable cost sharing.Failure to provide a refund to the covered person constitutesunprofessional conduct under chapter 18.130 RCW.
